messages:
jess: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we saw a routing reconcile race trigger cross-region TLS retry amplification. creating a compact action tracker here. please ack and add realistic ETAs.

Action items (short):
A) reconcile: enforce single-writer ordering for route updates to avoid transient dual-paths (owner: mike) - ETA: 2026-04-04
B) handshake throttling: add per-origin concurrent handshake cap + client-side retry caps (owner: sanjay) - ETA: 2026-03-31
C) probe + alerting: synthetic that injects inter-region cert failures and measures amplification (owner: lia) - ETA: 2026-03-27
D) emergency mitigation: feature-flag to prefer local region + short-circuit on amplification >1% (owner: jess) - ETA: 2026-03-25
E) customer comms: pre-drafted advisory & recommended config to avoid cascades for passthrough users (owner: product@redwood) - ETA: 2026-04-02

mike: ack. i'll add a mutex around the reconcile loop and a e2e that simulates partial route write to catch dual-edges. leaning to a backfill migration to reorder history.

sanjay: ack. plan: cap concurrent handshakes per peer to 8, add jittered backoff (min=40ms, max=1500ms), and expose a per-cluster override. will open PR for client and LB binary.

lia: ack. probe plan: run 1000 iterations across us-east-1 <-> eu-west-1 with 20 concurrency, measure error amplification and RPS. alert when amplification > 2x baseline. will post datadog dashboard link.

jess: mitigation note: the feature-flag should be opt-in for canary, keyboard: feature/prefer-local-on-amplify. i'll own playbook steps for short-term manual rollback (include dns/route revert commands).

mike: question: do we need to touch route controller and BGP announcer? or can the reconcile ordering change be contained to the controller?

sanjay: prefer controller-only change first. touching announcer increases blast radius. if controller-only doesn't fix, escalate to announce ordering.

lia: probe prototype curl snippet:
```
POST /internal/probe/simulate-handshake-failures
{ "pair": "us-east-1:eu-west-1", "concurrency": 20, "iterations": 1000 }
```
Threshold: alert if success_rate_degradation > 5% or amplification_ratio > 2.

jess: oncall-bot will create a short-lived monitor and a recurring check-in for 7 days. we should also add the probe to our nightly regression runs.

oncall-bot: Created followup ticket INF-4902 assigned to jess, mike, sanjay, lia. First sync scheduled 2026-03-29 16:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: region=eu-west-1, tag=reconcile-ordering.v2, start_ts=2812350005. dashboard: /dashboards/routing-reconcile-canary.

mike: pushed draft PR https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/3478 - includes reconcile reorder + integration test. seeking review from @sanjay and @lia.

sanjay: i'll review and add client patch after we confirm no latency regression. also will add a short note in changelog about client retry cap.

jess: thanks. please update this thread with status ticks. if anyone hits a blocker, ping me and we'll reassign. :eyes:
